description: Keyless. Resolve a structured Apier compliance error code into a Norwegian-bokmål Explanation envelope: summary, bokmål why, ordered fix_steps, optional documentation link + legal_basis, and an optional handover block (who / where / what / why) for errors a human must resolve (e.g. AUTH_INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, AUTH_NO_DELEGATION, SCOPE_MISSING) — agent-resolvable errors ship `handover: null`. Accepts any code from the closed EXPLAINER_ERROR_CODES catalogue. Optional flat context_org_number / context_scope / context_role / context_field / context_upstream_system strings carry placeholder values interpolated into the bokmål text; missing values fall back to 'ukjent <noun>'. Failure modes: VALIDATION_FAILED on an unknown code; a credential without `read:rulebook` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). For a company's live obligations rather than an error explanation, use get_company_obligations instead. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/error-handling
description_nb: Nøkkelfritt. Gjør en feilkode fra Apier om til en forklaringspakke på bokmål: sammendrag, begrunnelse, ordnede `fix_steps`, valgfri lenke og `legal_basis`, og en overleveringsblokk for feil et menneske må løse. Aksepterer alle koder i katalogen EXPLAINER_ERROR_CODES; flate `context_*`-felter bærer plassholderverdier. For et selskaps faktiske forpliktelser, bruk get_company_obligations i stedet.

context_field.description: Field name interpolated into the explanation.

context_org_number.description: Organisation the error relates to (9 digits).

context_role.description: Role code interpolated into the explanation.

context_scope.description: Scope token interpolated into the bokmål explanation.

context_upstream_system.description: Upstream system name interpolated into the explanation.
